## Activity

During October 2021, East City Eye Clinic recorded 175 captures. This represents the activity completed at the site during the month. The reported volume provides the basis for the review of image quality and grading outcomes. No new equipment faults were raised during this month.

## Image quality

Of the 175 captures, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.7 per cent. These results indicate that most captures were suitable for assessment, while a small proportion could not be graded. The ungradable captures remain relevant to the site’s operational review and should continue to be monitored alongside routine activity.

## Grading

Grading identified 42 referable results from the month’s activity. The median lag from capture to grading was 5 days. This provides the reported measure of the time between image capture and completion of grading. Overall, the activity, image quality and grading figures provide a summary of service performance at East City Eye Clinic during October 2021.
